pattern: solid nodule lying free in aerated lung, activation centred on the nodule; low nodules touch pleura, fissure or mediastinum, or are ground-glass
reason: consistent on LIDC and LUNA25; not size (volumes matched); contact is part of the pattern but solidity and conspicuity differ as well; classifier effect rank 1

pattern: small solid well-circumscribed nodule fully surrounded by aerated lung, activation centred on the nodule; low nodules of the same size touch the chest wall
reason: the clearest contrast of all pages; same concept as VISTA3D 202 in the other encoder; classifier effect rank 1

pattern: irregular, heterogeneous nodules (part-solid, lobulated or spiculated); low nodules are smooth, round and homogeneous, several calcified
reason: consistent on LIDC and LUNA25; five confirmed ratings agree at 30 nodules; the activation sits on one side of the nodule (image right) on most examples, so the heatmap does not mark the finding

pattern: small, very dense, sharply defined nodules, often calcified, activation centred on the nodule; low nodules are faint or ground-glass of the same size
reason: consistent; matches a benign calcified granuloma appearance; the feature also responds weakly to chest-wall soft tissue

pattern: dense solid nodules, many calcified, lying free in lung, activation 4-10 mm below and right of the nodule; low nodules are faint, ground-glass or attached to the wall
reason: consistent; overlaps 743 (density) and 202 (free position); calcification, subtlety and malignancy agree at 30 nodules

pattern: faint, ground-glass or ill-defined small nodules deep in the lung; activation fills the surrounding aerated lung; low nodules are small, solid and near the chest wall
reason: margin, texture and calcification agree at 30 nodules; the only kept pattern for non-solid or ill-defined nodules; location (distance from the wall) is mixed into the contrast

pattern: activation fills the surrounding lung; high nodules lie deep in the lung, low nodules near the chest wall
reason: same pattern as FMCIB 507 with a single confirmed rating; 507 represents it

pattern: activation fills the surrounding lung; high nodules faint and central, low nodules small, solid and near the wall
reason: same pattern as FMCIB 507; 507 represents it

pattern: activation always at the lower right edge of the nodule; high and low nodules are both large and irregular
reason: no visible difference between the groups; the activation position suggests a position-dependent response; malignancy association not visible

pattern: activation on structures away from the nodule (vessels, upper lung)
reason: no visible nodule pattern; malignancy difference at 30 nodules not significant (p 0.37)

pattern: activation almost absent near the nodule, with a blob at a fixed corner of the field in high and low examples
reason: no visible nodule pattern; corner response unrelated to the nodule

pattern: activation in aerated lung 4-10 mm beside the nodule; high nodules free in lung, low nodules against the wall
reason: the visible difference is mainly wall contact; VISTA3D 202 carries the same concept on the nodule itself
